full_judgment: 38. In judicial review of administrative actions, the Court has to start with the presumption of regularity of the official acts which is incorporated in illustration (e) to Section 114 of the Evidence Act. The burden of proof is on the party who alleges the contrary. In the present case, the petitioner has successfully rebutted the presumption. The case of Shinepukur Holdings Ltd., 50 DLR (AD) 189 is of no assistance to the respondents.
